reviews.text: I am writing this review out of extreme frustration and profound disappointment regarding the ongoing delays and incomplete work on a spa project contracted with Splash Pad Pool Builder in Royce City, TX. Getting this seemingly simple project over the finish line was an arduous struggle with constant project management issues that discredited the words that came out of the project manager's mouth, so buyers beware. The chronic lack of communication, infuriating unresponsiveness, disruptive pop-up visits to perform partial work, and outright "ghosting" when we were told to expect a visit are not just concerning – they indicate a deeply flawed operation. This experience was nothing short of a nightmare. I strongly and unequivocally encourage anyone considering a pool or spa installation to think twice. Save yourselves the hassle of not getting what you pay for. When deciding to choose a pool builder there are many options but we went with the best, Splashpad Pool Builders.

From design to final product we have been very impressed with their skill and knowledge. Our Project Manager (Josh “Red”) has really made the company look great with his knowledge, customer service and communication skills. You can count on Splashpad to make it right and do what they say and most importantly, ask for Josh aka Red to be your site Project Manager. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text: John is very professional and great person to work with. His work was excellent and finished the job when they promised. I would definitely use him again and would recommend him to anyone. Thank you splash pool for a great and professional service and excellent employees like John
reviews.author: Héctor Ibarra

reviews.text: The team at splash pads pools was professional and fast. We now have our dream pool at the lake and we love it!!
reviews.author: misty bice

reviews.text: From the initial consultation to outline their process and our options, SplashPad has been amazing to work with. Watching everything come together was an awesome experience. I've heard of people that maybe the project came together in the end but getting there was hard with other companies. We were very selective and we can say that every step there was communication, there was respect of our property, our time and this investment. Best build experience we've had and the fact that the experience will continue as they support us through the year, is just extra icing on the cake!
reviews.author: Ebony Nickerson

reviews.text: John was a great help when we discovered a leak. He was very responsive and was able to get someone on site the same day to fix our issue. He stayed in communication with us to ensure it was taken care of. Very much appreciate his help.
reviews.author: July Crockett

reviews.text: We were very impressed with Splash Pad Pool Builders.  They were very professional and completed our pool, quickly.  It was a pleasure doing business with everyone involved.
reviews.author: Cheryl Redman

reviews.text:
Just a few of the issues we ran into:
1. Lack of communication (we had to call to find out anything regarding the work)
2. Did not keep deadlines
3. Never knew when workers were coming
4. No supervision on the job and did not install the upgraded toe tile we wanted.
5 We also paid to have our grass replaced when they were done and now have two different varieties of grass.  They gave us the cheapest, dead grass they had.  We are still trying to get it to fill in.
reviews.author: Delra Woram

reviews.text: Kristen and Red did a great job. Any problems were handled quickly. The pool turned out better than we could have imagined. Started the project on June 6 and we were swimming by July 14.
reviews.author: Scott Hooper

reviews.text: Splash Pad pool builders came out and knocked this pool build out of the park. The Splash pad team and and all their contractors were always on time, professional, very helpful and saw our vision of the pool we wanted and ran with it. Jennifer helped us with the design and Slade not only nailed it all but did so way faster than we ever imagined. Very professional business and we highly recommend anyone looking into getting a pool to reach out to them. I give them 2 thumbs up and a solid 5 star rating for sure.
reviews.author: Jason Langford

reviews.text: We love our pool and can’t wait until it warms up.  Knowing that any job can have issues is important and ours had its share however because of John everything was great.  People make the difference and John G. at SPPB is the differentiator.
reviews.author: Steven E

reviews.text: I reached out to Splash Pad Pool Builder on getting an estimate for a new pool. We were contacted by our rep, Wayne. We knew exactly what we wanted and Wayne was able to bring it to life with a beautiful design. We are looking forward to many great memories in our new pool from Splash Pad Pool Builders!
reviews.author: Christy Lee

reviews.text: We had an excellent beginning to end experience in designing and building our new pool with SPPB! The entire team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and a high quality product. I would highly recommend them if you’re looking for a new pool in the DFW metroplex. Thank you!
reviews.author: Nicholas S Thomas

reviews.text: I highly recommend this company! Lucia helped us  make our dreams a reality. She was very professional and showed great time management during our project. Call them if you haven’t already!
reviews.author: Gabrielle Guardado

reviews.text: There has probably been no more challenging time than now to build a pool given supply chain issues, COVID, demand etc. however Josh and Jeremiah have delivered our dream backyard. Everyone compliments us on the finished product and we are loving it every day. The process is what it is when building a pool but even after the pool was finished they were able to address any small outstanding items to make sure they were resolved. Very happy with our SplashPad pool!
reviews.author: Simon Beresford

reviews.text: I’ll start by saying, we’re going to miss these guys!  We had a wonderful experience building our dream pool! We interviewed many builders and what set Splash Pad Pool Builder aside from the rest was the fact that they do EVERYTHING!  They not only build the pool, but they do the re-sodding, irrigation, etc. all included in the cost of the pool which was lower than all the rest who didn’t provide the additional services. Splash Pad Pool Builder were willing to deal with our, difficult to access, backyard where other pool builders turned us down. Another plus is they provide a port-a-potty on site for their workers. The guys were so patient with us and our many many questions and always answered our calls and texts quickly.  We developed such a great trust/relationship with Chris, Slade and Mick and can’t say enough good things about them.  Not to mention, Splash Pad Pool Builder finished our pool so fast! Dig day was August 11th and we were swimming in it by September 26th! You won’t go wrong if you choose Splash Pad Pool Builder to build your dream pool!
reviews.author: Tammy Primrose

reviews.text: Unprofessional, lack of accountability and lack of response.  If you are interested in getting a pool built, LOOK ELSEWHERE.  This company will take your money, but you'll be left with an unfinished pool and property damages.  I WOULD NOT recommend Splash Pad Pool Builder.
reviews.author: Jordan Kalber

reviews.text: We had Splash pad pool builders come and and give us a quote for a pool. The were prompt for both the initial appointment and our follow up appointment. Wayne was our point of contact and walked us through every step of the process. I cannot recommend him enough. He was very professional and very knowledgeable. He kept in contact with us regularly and was always available to answer any questions we had. I would highly recommend working with Wayne and Splash Pad Pool builders.
reviews.author: Chris Robbins

reviews.text:
Our experience was absolutely fantastic! I don’t recall a time when I needed them during our build, that they were not available. Such a relief to have an invested team with values indicative of what they promised.
Rodomontade is in order!

Thank you!
Carl & Inez
reviews.author: Inez Eddington

reviews.text: Our pool is amazing! It came out so great and faster than expected. Chris was great during the design process and Slade was awesome during the build, he answered all of my questions and the communication of the guys was above and beyond what I expected! They are all so professional and I could go on and on all day about how happy we are with the outcome of our pool. Thanks again guys!
reviews.author: Shane Rosencrance

reviews.text:
These guys were great! Very personable, easy to talk to, always upbeat, patient , polite and professional. Red even came out on his personal time.
We would recommend these guys to anyone.
Thank you so much!
reviews.author: carl eddington

reviews.text: Top notch service with Splash Pad Pool Builders and Fast! Josh and the Team are great to work with and handled business. If your in the market for a pool I definitely recommend this company.  Thank you guys again.. If we could give you 10 stars we would!!!!
reviews.author: R R

reviews.text: I just signed up with splash pools but so far I have had a great experience. Wayne is very attentive and has answered all questions my wife and I have had. I am looking forward to working with the rest of the team and hoping that I get the same responses. I have gotten so far. I will keep you posted.
reviews.author: Clyde Hux

reviews.text: Wayne visited with my wife and I at our house 5 times and made sure all of our questions and concerns were addressed. We had an idea of what we want but not really sure. He guided us through the process, offered ideas, and explained how the process works until we were comfortable with our decision. We changed things multiple times and he always stayed positive and assured us his goal is to make our dream come true. So we signed and got the ball rolling. We are excited and  cannot wait to start excavation. Wayne is "The Man" More to come after the pool is complete. We feel really blessed to have the opportunity to have Wayne and Splash Pad build our dream pool.
reviews.author: shean boykin

reviews.text: We just finished our pool with Splashpad Pools!  We couldn’t be more happy with the outcome. The pool is beautiful, they were easy to work with, and very responsive.
reviews.author: Candy Lee

reviews.text: Chris was the most professional salesman that I’ve ever dealt with. He is not your typical salesman. He becomes your friend and your neighbor and wants what is best for you regardless of what’s in it for him. He explained to me in detail the design of the pool that I described to him. He was prompt on returning phone calls, emails and text messages whether it was early in the morning or on weekends. Overall, I truly enjoyed the experience and not once were stressed out about buying a pool. I would recommend him to anyone.
reviews.author: Lauren Taylor

reviews.text: I could literally cry at how happy I am with my new backyard pool paradise! I have dreamed of having a pool for years and had a clear vision of what I wanted! Splash pad pool builder greatly exceeded my expectations! My pool is gorgeous! Their pricing was right and on top of that their customer service was amazing. They were extremely timely with not only the building of my pool but all their responses with me. I could not be happier! They truly made my dream a reality! Thank you splash pad pool builder!
reviews.author: Joanna Schmitz

reviews.text: The entire team at Splash Pad Pool Builder, from our sales rep Chris, to our site supervisor Slade, and everyone involved in our build made our dream of a backyard oasis come to light. We will enjoy this for many years. Thank you, The Goldsberry’s.
reviews.author: Dawn Goldsberry

reviews.text: My husband and I used Splash Pad to build our dream pool and couldn't be happier! We were in great hands with Chris, Josh and Amberly - they over delivered!
reviews.author: Gabe Herron

reviews.text:
Guy named Chris showed up to our appointment, took some measurements and said he’d have the design and quote by end of day. Week went by, nothing. Had to call and text him 3x before he responded . Said he sent the quote and design but I never received anything . Called and texted him another 2x to no avail . No call back or text, very unprofessional.
Look for another pool company.
reviews.author: Javier Rodriguez

reviews.text:
Overall, this was a great experience start-to-finish. We never felt pressured, upsold, etc. The initial meeting captured what we wanted and the final product matched what was discussed.

The only critique we have is improved/increased communication. Ex - during pool filling, a contractor told our nanny (instead of one of us) about how high to fill the pool. Perhaps a packet (paper or digital) could be used to detail what steps to do and when to do them just so nothing gets lost in the mix.
reviews.author: Dan Goodman

reviews.text: We had the team over to do a presentation and you were very impressed with their professionalism and level of communication. The process has been great so far and our kids and I are very excited about swimming in our pool this summer.
reviews.author: Joseph Lauder

reviews.text: Started with Jennifer and then she transitioned us to Wayne after a job change.  The experience has been wonderful so far.  Both reps were knowledgeable and willing to help with suggestions.  Very professional.
reviews.author: Kinniburgh Brats

reviews.text: Wayne came out and put together a great bid package. Knowledgeable, professional and answered a million questions. We did decide not to install a pool though. But that dosent take anything away from Splash Pad and Wayne. If we ever decide to move forward. These guys will definitely be the ones building it
reviews.author: Brian Jones

reviews.text: John from the Warranty side was great! Within one day, called me back, went to check the broken pump out, and had Pentair out to fix it, all before I got home from work!
reviews.author: Brian Nevans

reviews.text: Splash Pad were very professional. The design and quality of work was top notch. Highly recommend them for your pool needs.
reviews.author: Chris Langel

reviews.text: Chris Taylor and the entire Splash Pad Pool team were fantastic and very very professional during the pre-construction, construction & post-construction. Well use them again on other backyard projects.
reviews.author: Jerry Valentine

reviews.text: The entire process was fantastic! Michael got everything rolling for us and Beth and Travis helped with everything and answered all of our questions. They stuck with us and resolved all of our issues if they came up. Thank you for everything!
reviews.author: Sarah Fielden

reviews.text: Wayne was great to work with. He designed our pool exactly how we wanted & got us under our budget. We couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Ashley Richardson

reviews.text: Splash Pad did an awesome job with our pool. The whole process was great, painless, and well done.
reviews.author: Mason Randall
